commons.title: Jinuo Village.jpg
commons.description: Preparations for the big yearly festival, this year celebrated on February 8th 2010. The Jino or Jinuo are an ethnic minority in Yunnan Province, China. The photo is taken in the village Baka close to Menglun.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption and source category identify the Jino/Jinuo people, and the image visibly shows a group in coordinated traditional dress preparing for their festival.
